diagrams.useCase:
@startuml
!theme plain
left to right direction
title Diagramme des cas d'utilisation (API)

actor "Client" as client
actor "Admin" as admin

rectangle "Backend" {
  usecase "GET /api/docs.json" as GET__api_docs_json
  usecase "POST /api/chat" as POST__api_chat
  usecase "GET /api/conversations" as GET__api_conversations
  usecase "GET /api/conversations/:id" as GET__api_conversations__id
  usecase "DELETE /api/conversations/:id" as DELETE__api_conversations__id
  usecase "GET /api/llm/health" as GET__api_llm_health
  usecase "GET /api/test-stream" as GET__api_test_stream
}

client --> GET__api_docs_json
client --> POST__api_chat
client --> GET__api_conversations
client --> GET__api_conversations__id
admin --> DELETE__api_conversations__id
client --> GET__api_llm_health
client --> GET__api_test_stream

@enduml
